title: Collect corroborating evidence: sensitive_file
reason: HTTP status and response size alone do not establish whether the target file was returned, read or executed.
where_to_check: Historical response bodies, application file-read records and host file-access audit logs;Web server/proxy routing configuration and historical generic error-page responses
method: Correlate the recorded interval, host, URI and request identifiers; source IP alone is not verified identity.
success_evidence: Records showing that the response contained nonpublic file contents, or that an unauthorized file read or execution occurred.
failure_evidence: Records showing rejection before file access, or processing that returned no sensitive information without reading the target file.

title: Collect corroborating evidence: sqli
reason: Access logs do not record the backend queries executed or the data retrieved or changed.
where_to_check: Application processing/error logs and historical responses;Audit logs for the relevant database, directory service or XML query processing
method: Correlate the recorded interval, host, URI and request identifiers; source IP alone is not verified identity.
success_evidence: Records showing that input in the request caused an unintended query and data retrieval, modification or authentication bypass.
failure_evidence: Records showing rejection before query execution, or processing in which the input was treated as a value and caused no unintended query or result.

title: Collect corroborating evidence: xss
reason: Access logs alone do not show how input was embedded in responses or stored data, or whether it executed in a browser.
where_to_check: Historical response HTML, stored data and records of the pages displaying it;Execution/network records from the relevant browser and CSP reports
method: Correlate the recorded interval, host, URI and request identifiers; source IP alone is not verified identity.
success_evidence: Records showing that a script derived from the input executed on the target page. Reflection or storage alone does not confirm execution.
failure_evidence: Records showing input rejection, or escaping that prevented execution at the relevant output location. CSP blocking records apply to the specific execution attempt.
